title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Managerial Decision Making
description: Dive into the dynamic world of managerial decision-making, where strategy, bias, and technology converge to shape organizational outcomes.
longDescription: This course offers a comprehensive exploration of managerial decision-making, uncovering the sequential stages, biases, and technological advancements that influence strategic choices. Participants will delve into the intricacies of individual and group decision-making, learning techniques to optimize routine decisions and strategies to address biases. Additionally, the course examines the role of technology in enhancing decision-making processes, with a focus on data analytics, AI, and decision support systems.
courseDetails: Understand leadership's role in decision-making. Explore Kurt Lewin's decision-making model. Analyze factors influencing leadership decisions. Differentiate decision-making aspects. Identify key decision categories in organizations. Learn about diverse decision types. Link managerial levels to decision types. Contrast rational and behavioral perspectives in decision-making. Acquire a comprehensive understanding of tools and techniques crucial for managerial decision-making processes. Grasp the principles and applications of Operations Research (OR) in problem-solving and decision-making contexts. Evaluate the profound impact of Operations Research (OR). Explore the foundational decision-making models. Classify and comprehend the taxonomy of decision-making models. Define strategic problem-solving and its significance in managerial decision-making. Discuss established frameworks (McKinsey’s 8-step process) for structured problem-solving. Explore technology's role in augmenting decision-making processes, emphasizing data analytics, AI, and decision support systems. Highlight how technology enhances problem-solving stages like data processing, collaboration, decision analysis, and implementation. Include real-life examples demonstrating the successful application of problem-solving frameworks coupled with technology in managerial decision-making scenarios. Discuss challenges faced when implementing these frameworks and technologies, including issues with data accuracy, bias, and adaptability. Participants will gain insights into the systematic stages of managerial decision-making and explore methods to enhance decision quality among managers. They will recognize the impact of experience on decision-making and learn strategies to optimize routine decisions while navigating critical, non-routine choices. Additionally, participants will examine decision-making dynamics in group settings and identify and address biases that influence the process. After the successful completion of this course, you will be able to: Insights Into Managerial Decision-Making Biases: Decision Dynamics in Leadership and Management Managerial Decision-Making Tools and Techniques Strategic Problem-Solving Framework And Technology In Decision-Making
